description: Consumer-driven contract test spec contract — validates framework, broker configuration, interaction quality, and OpenAPI alignment

rules.description: framework must be one of: pact, pactflow, spring-cloud-contract, dredd, schemathesis
broker.url must use environment variable syntax, not a hardcoded URL
publishResults must be true when broker is declared
Interaction paths must exist in referenced OpenAPI spec
Interactions must not use empty response bodies or wildcard matchers
validateAgainstOpenApi must be true when openApiSpec is declared
